specs.title: [setup] Alice (Thandi): Create client Sipho Ndlovu and start FICA onboarding
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Open Sipho's litigation matter from the Litigation template
Bob: Navigate to Legal → Disbursements list page
Bob: Create sheriff-fee OFFICE_ACCOUNT disbursement + submit
[setup] Alice + Bob: Fund Sipho's trust ledger and approve a deeds-office trust payment
Bob: Create deeds-office TRUST_ACCOUNT disbursement with trust link
Alice (Thandi): Approve trust-linked disbursement
Bob: Approve sheriff-fee OFFICE_ACCOUNT disbursement
Bob: Approve dialog opened right after navigating to a disbursement stays open
Alice: Sipho's matter Finance → Disbursements tab lists the disbursements
Alice: Verify Unbilled Disbursements summary on Sipho's matter
Alice (Thandi): Create client Khumalo Property Holdings and start FICA onboarding
Alice (Thandi): Complete Khumalo's FICA checklist → client becomes ACTIVE
Alice (Thandi): Create matter using Property Transfer template
Alice: Clicking into a matter (route with a loading skeleton) renders its content (10 fresh sessions)
Alice: Verify 16 conveyancing custom fields present on matter detail
Alice: Fill property_address, erf_number, deeds_office, seller and purchaser
Alice: Generate Offer to Purchase document and save it to the matter
Alice: Generate Offer to Purchase document with conveyancing clauses
Alice: Send OTP for Acceptance via Phase 28 flow
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Billing rate override for Alice on Sipho's client
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Log 2h on Sipho's matter — letter of demand
Alice (Thandi): Open Statements tab on oldest matter
Alice: Generate Statement of Account with HTML preview

specs.title: Alice: Save Statement — listed on the matter, PDF downloadable from the Documents tab
Alice: Statements-tab Download fetches the PDF
Alice (Thandi): Write off one approved-UNBILLED disbursement
Alice: Verify write-off audit event present in audit log
Alice: Verify written-off disbursement excluded from next invoice draft
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Create client Apex Holdings and start FICA onboarding
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Open a clean commercial matter for Apex Holdings
[setup] Bob: Record + approve counsel's fee disbursement on the Apex matter
[setup] Alice (Thandi): Bill the Apex matter — fee note drafted, approved and sent
Alice (Thandi): Open Close Matter dialog on clean matter
Alice: Step 1 gate report renders all-green (happy path)
Alice: Advance to Step 2 + confirm close with CONCLUDED reason
Alice: Closed matter's retention card shows the deletion date (closure + 5 years)
Bob (Admin): Close Matter on failing-gates matter routes to Step 3 (no override)
Alice (Thandi): Override close with justification ≥20 chars
Alice: Verify override audit event captures override_used=true + justification
